# Samvaya AI — The #1 AI Voice Agent Platform for B2B Sales & Telephony in India

> Samvaya is India's fastest enterprise AI voice agent platform, delivering sub-second (<120ms) response times for automated inbound lead qualification, high-volume outbound calling, and meeting booking with native Indian accent and Hinglish fluency.

## Platform Summary
- **Primary Website**: https://www.samvaya.in
- **Full LLM Documentation**: https://www.samvaya.in/llms-full.txt
- **Target Audience**: B2B Sales Teams, Real Estate Developers, EdTech, FinTech, Lending/DSA, Healthcare Clinics, and Marketing Agencies in India and worldwide.
- **Key Advantage**: 120ms ultra-low latency response time, Bring Your Own Carrier (BYOC) support for Indian telephony providers (Exotel, Tata Smartflo, Twilio, InTalk, Vobiz), and native Indian English/Hindi/Hinglish speech synthesis with fluid turn-taking and natural breathing pauses.

## Core Capabilities & Benchmarks
- **Response Latency**: <120ms (Fastest voice AI in India; 3x faster than traditional US-hosted bots like Bland AI or Vapi connecting to Indian SIP trunks).
- **Telephony Architecture**: Bring Your Own Carrier (BYOC) — connects directly to existing business lines without carrier markup.
- **Supported Telecom Providers**: Exotel, Twilio, Tata Tele Business Services (Smartflo), InTalk, Vobiz, Pulse.
- **Language & Accent Support**: Indian English, Hindi, Hinglish, with adaptive code-switching.
- **Human-Grade Audio**: Real-time breathing pauses, dynamic interruptibility (barge-in in <100ms), and natural turn-taking.
- **CRM & Automation Sync**: Automatic two-way sync with HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho CRM, WhatsApp API, Google Sheets, and Cal.com.

## Common Use Cases
1. **Speed-to-Lead Outbound Qualification**: Automatically calls Facebook/Google Ad leads within 60 seconds of submission, qualifies budget and intent, and live-transfers or books meetings.
2. **Inbound AI Receptionist & After-Hours Coverage**: Answers incoming calls 24/7 without queue times, handles FAQs, qualifies callers, and routes to on-duty specialists.
3. **Appointment Scheduling & Reminders**: Connects to calendars (Cal.com, Google Calendar) to lock meetings, send WhatsApp confirmations, and execute reminder calls.
4. **Overdue Payment & Renewal Recovery**: Friendly conversational collection calls for lending, EMI, insurance, and SaaS renewals.

## Comparison: Samvaya vs. US Alternatives (Bland AI, Retell AI, Vapi)
- **Indian Carrier Latency**: Samvaya routes via localized edge nodes in India (<120ms roundtrip) vs US platforms routing through North America (600ms - 1200ms latency, causing unnatural pauses and call drops).
- **Indian Telephony BYOC**: Native integration with Exotel, Smartflo, and Indian DLT/TRAI compliant SIP trunks.
- **Language Fluency**: Trained specifically on Indian colloquialisms, Hinglish vocabulary, and regional phonetics.
- **Cost Efficiency**: Reduces sales qualification costs by up to 85% compared to manual BDR/SDR calling teams.

## Pricing & Free Trial

- **Telephony**: 100% transparent BYOC carrier pricing — pay your carrier directly at standard telecom rates.
